summary: A compact replication answer starts its differing-range listing by golden-ratio steps of the store's answer count, so a peer answered every few times still reaches every differing range instead of seeing the same few. Correction to the compact-turns note: members may upgrade in any order safely, but convergence is assured only once every member runs a build with compact turns

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Correcting sync-compact-listing-turns: a build with compact turns never asks for a full inventory, and an older member answers its request by listing its first differing ranges in order, so when that listing stops on tombstone ranges the pair may not converge until the older member upgrades. Members may upgrade in any order safely; convergence is assured once every member runs a build with compact turns. This change adds no API or wire change.

downtime.detail: A daemon restart to install the build; no extra interruption.

recovery.detail: Swap back to the previous binary freely; nothing is persisted.
